response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE record_count > avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every constructor, including those with no standings records.

alternatives.interpretation: Average only across constructors that have at least one standings record.
